authority.query: Verify the exact entity represented by website sushiro.com.tw (title: 首頁 - 台湾スシロー 台灣壽司郎). Find only public sources that clearly refer to this exact website or brand. Exclude similarly named but unrelated entities. Return unknown if entity alignment cannot be verified. Cite every retained source. Start with exactly ALIASES: name1 | name2 using only names supported by the official site or corroborating sources; otherwise write ALIASES: UNKNOWN.
authority.answer:
ALIASES: 台灣壽司郎 | 台湾スシロー

The website **sushiro.com.tw** aligns with the Taiwan operation of Sushiro, branded as **台灣壽司郎** in traditional Chinese and **台湾スシロー** in Japanese on the site title you provided. The Google Play listing for the Taiwan app also uses **台灣壽司郎** and an official support email at **sushiro.com.tw**, which corroborates that this domain belongs to the Taiwan Sushiro brand.[3]

Public sources that clearly refer to this same brand include:
- The Google Play listing for **台灣壽司郎**, which lists support email **TW.SP@sushiro.com.tw** and company contact information tied to Sushiro.[3]
- Taiwan News coverage referring specifically to **Sushiro in Taiwan**, matching the Taiwan brand context rather than the Japanese parent chain generally.[4]

The Japanese parent brand **Sushiro / Akindo Sushiro** is a separate corporate identity and should not be used as an alias for the Taiwan site unless directly supported by the Taiwan official site; based on the provided sources, the safest verified aliases are **台灣壽司郎** and **台湾スシロー**
